opportunities.title: Grinch and Kisses holiday packs -> on-pack conversion funnel for the 2027 run
opportunities.what_is_happening: Hershey's 2026 holiday line includes co-branded Dr. Seuss Grinch packaging, including a giftable Grinch milk chocolate bar 6-pack. It also includes a limited-edition Hershey's Kisses gift-wrapping foil kit sold at shop.hersheys.com/holiday on Cyber Monday, Nov. 30.
opportunities.why_flowcode: The holiday packs reach shoppers but offer no measurable digital next step and capture no first-party data. The only link in the release is the online shop URL. A Flowcode on the pack leading to a FlowHub (Grinch sweepstakes, gifting ideas, shop link) would capture each scanner into FlowID and sync them to the CRM. The destination can change after printing.
opportunities.confidence_why: Brand's own press release across three signals; Capri Sun is a close match: a front-of-pack licensed sweepstakes from a national CPG snack brand.
opportunities.size_why: Seasonal packaging on a national confectionery brand.
opportunities.timing_why: The 2026 holiday packs are already produced and on shelves, so the realistic pitch is the 2027 holiday run.
opportunities.suggested_play: For the 2027 holiday line, put a Flowcode on the front of the Grinch 6-pack and the Kisses gift packs that opens a 'Scan to Win' holiday FlowHub. Every entrant becomes a FlowID contact synced to Hershey's CRM. Capri Sun's front-of-pack sweepstakes drove 28K+ sweepstakes submissions and became a Top 3 performing code across the Kraft Heinz portfolio, and one print run can carry later seasonal promotions.
opportunities.first_step: Email the Hershey's seasonal Brand Manager with the Capri Sun case study and ask when 2027 holiday packaging artwork locks.

opportunities.title: Creme Bars 'Pinky Up' TV and social -> scannable spots with one shared identity
opportunities.what_is_happening: Hershey's launched Salted Caramel and Affogato Creme Bars in September 2026 with a KATSEYE 'Pinky Up' TV commercial. The campaign spans CTV, national TV, digital video, display, paid social, streaming audio, influencer and earned media, with sampling, pop-ups and an Uber partnership planned to follow.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Neither the spot nor the social and influencer work shows a QR code or trackable link. Hershey can't tie the national TV and CTV spend to actions or to people. A Flowcode in the spot, FlowURLs in creator posts, and Analytics by network and creative would route both channels to one FlowHub and attribute them to the same people.
opportunities.confidence_why: Two agreeing trade-press signals; PIM Brands is a close match: a scannable multi-network TV spot for a snack brand, with media shifted on real-time data.
opportunities.size_why: National TV and CTV plus paid social and influencer reach for a new product line.
opportunities.timing_why: The launch spot was produced in September; the opening is the next flight or the planned sampling and pop-up follow-ons.
opportunities.suggested_play: On the next Creme Bars flight, add a Flowcode to the 'Pinky Up' spot that opens a FlowHub with a KATSEYE-themed sweepstakes and a where-to-buy link. Use FlowURLs with the same FlowHub in influencer posts. Analytics would show which network, creative and creator drives entries, the way PIM Brands captured 32k new contacts at a 56% conversion rate and shifted placements in real time.
opportunities.first_step: Reach the Creme Bars Media / Advertising lead with the PIM Brands case study and ask about the next TV/CTV flight and the follow-on activations.

opportunities.title: Reese's Pie limited drop -> on-pack and in-club demand capture
opportunities.what_is_happening: Reese's is bringing back its supersized Reese's Pie as a Thanksgiving dessert. It went on sale Nov. 16, 2026 at shop.hersheys.com for $49.99 (limit 2 per order) and has been in limited quantities at select warehouse club locations. Trade press frames it as Hershey's move into dessert and bakery, beyond the candy aisle.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Hershey already drives traffic to a shop URL, but the warehouse-club units carry no measurable digital step. Buyers who miss the limited drop leave no first-party data. A Flowcode on the Pie box and club display leading to a FlowHub (serving ideas, next-drop alert sign-up) would capture buyers and fans into FlowID. It would also show which club locations convert.
opportunities.confidence_why: Brand's own press release plus trade press; LOVE CORN is a solid packaging-to-CRM match, though a limited-drop dessert is a looser analogy.
opportunities.size_why: A limited-quantity item sold online and at select warehouse clubs.
opportunities.timing_why: This year's units are produced and selling; the product returns seasonally, so pitch the next drop.
opportunities.suggested_play: For the next Reese's Pie return, print a Flowcode on the box and club signage that opens a FlowHub with serving ideas and a 'get notified for the next drop' sign-up into FlowID. LOVE CORN turned packaging scans into a 62% CRM conversion rate and 27k new customers captured, and here that audience would become a built-in launch list for Hershey's new dessert line.
opportunities.first_step: Send the Reese's Brand Manager the LOVE CORN case study with a one-page mock of a drop-alert FlowHub for the next Reese's Pie release.

opportunities.title: Twizzlers CFL postseason sponsorship -> first-party fan capture
opportunities.what_is_happening: Hershey Canada's Twizzlers became an official sponsor of the 2026 CFL postseason, including the Grey Cup.
opportunities.why_flowcode: The sponsorship reaches football fans but shows no QR code or link. Fan data stays with the league instead of Hershey. Flowcodes on sponsor signage and activations leading to a Twizzlers FlowHub (sweepstakes, offer) would capture each fan into FlowID, with Smart Rules blocking duplicate entries.
opportunities.confidence_why: A single trade-press source; the Penguins in-venue sports activation is a reasonable but not same-category match.
opportunities.size_why: A national pro-league postseason sponsorship, including the Grey Cup.
opportunities.timing_why: The postseason is late in its run; the realistic pitch is the next season's activation.
opportunities.suggested_play: Pitch Hershey Canada on adding Flowcodes to Twizzlers in-stadium signage and broadcast sponsor moments for the next CFL season, leading to a Twizzlers sweepstakes FlowHub with FlowID capture. The Pittsburgh Penguins drove an 88% conversion rate and $8,000 revenue generated in 30 mins from in-arena Flowcodes.
opportunities.first_step: Contact Hershey Canada's Sponsorships lead with the Penguins case study and ask how they plan to measure the CFL deal next season.

opportunities.title: Recurring Hershey pop-ups -> turn giveaways and recipe cards into first-party contacts

Hershey's Super Sweet Adventure ran as a ticketed pop-up and retail store at Tysons Corner Center for more than four months, through Labor Day. Sampling and pop-ups are planned to follow the Creme Bars launch.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Hershey keeps running in-person activations that hand out product and printed recipe cards but capture no first-party data. A Flowcode on recipe cards, cups and signage leading to a FlowHub would add each visitor to FlowID. Smart Rules would block duplicate giveaway claims.
opportunities.confidence_why: Several agreeing signals show a repeated pop-up pattern, but the sources are secondary and Feld is an entertainment, not CPG, analogy.
opportunities.timing_why: The cited pop-ups have ended, but more Creme Bars sampling and pop-ups are planned, so the next activation is still open.
opportunities.suggested_play: For the planned Creme Bars sampling and pop-ups, put a Flowcode on every sample, recipe card and sign that opens a branded FlowHub to claim the giveaway or a recipe. Each visitor is captured in FlowID, and Smart Rules stop duplicate claims, as in Feld's Monster Jam treasure hunt.
opportunities.first_step: Ask the Experiential Marketing lead for the calendar of upcoming Creme Bars sampling and pop-up dates.
